title: geissorhiza juncea var. pallidiflora
intro: Geissorhiza juncea var. pallidiflora, commonly known as the Pale Yellow Geissorhiza, is a plant species in the Iridaceae family. It is a bulbous perennial with yellow flowers that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The Pale Yellow Geissorhiza has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
